description: Find the shortest chain of relations connecting two entities in a Graph knowledge base (breadth-first, direction-agnostic). Answers "how are X and Y related?" with the hop-by-hop path. Wire a Knowledge Base node into knowledge_base, same as the search nodes.

inputs.name: from
inputs.description: The starting entity — its name (case-insensitive) or id.

inputs.name: to
inputs.description: The target entity — its name (case-insensitive) or id.

inputs.name: knowledge_base
inputs.description: The knowledge base to traverse, from a Knowledge Base node. If omitted, falls back to the flow's default knowledge base.

inputs.name: max_depth
inputs.description: Maximum number of hops to search before giving up.

outputs.name: found
outputs.description: Whether a path exists within max_depth

outputs.name: hops
outputs.description: Number of relations in the path (0 when from = to)

outputs.name: steps
outputs.description: The path, node by node: [{ node, via_edge? }] — via_edge names the relation that reached each node

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Error message if it failed (including unknown entities)
